name: Cypher Metaverse Inc.
summary: Cypher Metaverse Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in identifying investments in the technology, biotechnology, cannabis, and CBD wellness sectors. The company was formerly known as 360 Blockchain Inc. and changed its name to Cypher Metaverse Inc. in February 2019. Cypher Metaverse Inc. was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.
